name: Monarch Butterfly Biosphere Reserve
story: The Monarch Butterfly Biosphere Reserve is located in Mexico within the Trans-Mexican Volcanic Belt pine-oak forests ecoregion, on the border of Michoacan and State of Mexico. Millions of butterflies arrive in the reserve annually to inhabit oyamel fir forests.
matters: The reserve is a World Heritage Site containing most of the overwintering sites of the eastern population of the monarch butterfly, serving to protect the butterfly species and its habitat.
